notes.title: Happy Chinese New Year!
notes.content:
Dear all!

Happy Chinese New Year! May the Year of the Snake bring you good fortune and happiness! 🐍

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45173134/f52e9cc36995853ca51540b2429b0fa78012d820.png[/img]

We’re excited to announce that Super Alloy Crush will be part of Steam’s Chinese New Year Sale! During January 27 - February 10, we’ll also be hosting live streams!

Grab your friends and join Kelly and No. 02 on an epic journey to uncover cosmic treasures!
